items.source: Resolves the underlying URI into a full aggregate, potentially applying the configured identifier extractor.
items.translation: 解析底层 URI 为完整的聚合，并可能应用配置的标识符提取器。

items.source: Resolves the underlying URI into an aggregate identifier, potentially applying the registered identifier extractor.
items.translation: 将底层 URI 解析为聚合标识符，并可能应用已注册的标识符提取器。

items.source: Creates a new AggregateReference resolving the identifier source value from the given UriComponents.
items.translation: 创建一个新AggregateReference，从给定的UriComponents解析标识符源值。

items.source: Returns the source URI.
items.translation: 返回源URI。

items.source: IllegalStateException - in case the value resolved is null.
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果解析后的值为 null。

items.source:
Represents a reference to an aggregate backed by a URI. It can be resolved into an aggregate identifier or the
aggregate instance itself.
items.translation: 表示对由 URI 支持的聚合的引用。它可以解析为聚合标识符或聚合实例本身。
